delivery.commit_subject: PKT-005: finalize degradation banner and SSE substrate packet family

handoffs.message: PKT-005 packet family complete. Both substrates — global degradation banner and SSE reconciliation substrate — are packetized with screen specs, BFF contracts, example payloads, and coordination handoff files. Please review the packet family doc and supporting artifacts.

Review changes requested. See docs/reviews/PKT-005-review-codex.md: clarify banner aggregation for split-read PKT-002 Incident Home; align meta.surfaces status semantics with inherited packets; resolve backend-vs-local banner authority after SSE.

Please re-review PKT-005. All three blocking items from docs/reviews/PKT-005-review-codex.md have been addressed: (1) split-read aggregation rule added for PKT-002 Incident Home — BFF and screen contracts now define how merged surface maps from independent reads feed the banner; (2) per-surface status enum aligned with existing packets — only ok|degraded|unavailable; STALE variant now derived from meta.staleness.served_from, not a surface status value; (3) SSE banner authority conflict resolved — SSE substrate spec now explicitly states SSE events do not update banner state; packet family inheritance rule updated accordingly.

Residual conflict remains: docs/screens/PKT-005-degradation-banner.md still says banner updates on an 'SSE snapshot event'. Align that sentence with the backend-authority rule in PKT-005 SSE/pkt-family docs. See docs/reviews/PKT-005-review-codex.md.

Single residual conflict fixed: docs/screens/PKT-005-degradation-banner.md line 80 now reads 'Banner state is updated when the screen receives a fresh BFF meta snapshot — from initial load, polling, or an explicit full refetch triggered after a significant SSE event. SSE event payloads do not carry meta snapshots and must not be used to update banner state directly.' This matches the backend-authority rule in the SSE substrate and packet-family inheritance rules. Please re-review.
Residual backend-authority conflict resolved. PKT-005 is approved; owner should finalize to done.
